claim: Cloudflare's current audit skill requires confirmed findings to carry an ordered entrypoint/propagation/sink trace with file and line locations, and separates confirmed findings from unresolved validation leads.
notes: Latest remote main was verified at this revision on 2026-09-18. Workflow capability observed in source; no detection-quality or market-demand inference is made.

claim: The security full-report renderer prints each evidence type and description but omits evidence file/line, source, sink, and attackPath fields already present in the normalized finding model; the engine prompt requests source and sink.
notes: Finding file/startLine is separately included. This evidence gap concerns the full Markdown audit artifact; it does not establish user demand or justify changing finding acceptance policy.
